description.zh: 按住右键画一下：后退、前进、回到顶部、关闭窗口、打开 Win顺 搜索框……每个手势都能改成按键或打开程序。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Hold the right button and draw: back, forward, to the top, close the window, open WinShun's search… Each gesture can press keys or open a program instead. Not in windows run as administrator

hint.zh: 每个手势填一个动作：后退、前进、回到顶部、到底部、刷新、关闭窗口、关闭标签页、最小化、最大化、搜索框（Win顺 的）；或按键，如 Ctrl+W、Alt+Left、F5；或要打开的程序、快捷方式、文件夹、网址。留空就不用这个手势
hint.en: One action per gesture: back, forward, top, bottom, refresh, close, closetab, minimize, maximize, search (WinShun's); or keys such as Ctrl+W, Alt+Left, F5; or a program, shortcut, folder or web address to open. Empty: the gesture is off

hint.zh: 默认打开 Win顺 搜索框，再画一次收起
hint.en: Opens WinShun's search box by default; draw it again to close it

hint.zh: 方向 = 动作，用分号隔开。方向写箭头或字母 L R U D（左右上下），最多 6 段。例如：↑← = Ctrl+Shift+T; RL = notepad.exe
hint.en: directions = action, separated by semicolons. Directions as arrows or the letters L R U D, up to 6. For example: ↑← = Ctrl+Shift+T; RL = notepad.exe

hint.zh: 程序名用分号隔开，例如 photoshop.exe;mstsc.exe。这些程序里右键和平常一样
hint.en: Program names separated by semicolons, e.g. photoshop.exe;mstsc.exe. The right button is plain there

title.zh: 画出轨迹和将要做的事
title.en: Draw the trail and what it will do

title.zh: 全屏的程序里也用手势

hint.zh: 关着时，游戏、放幻灯片、全屏看视频时右键和平常一样
hint.en: Off: in games, slide shows and full-screen video the right button is plain
